messages.author: cd18384f25f162ff
messages.subject: Feature request: SQLite import
parts:
I find SQLite to be a valuable utility for holding datasets in a
relational database format, without all of the admin overhead
associated with MySQL, Oracle and other traditional RDBMS. It would be
double great to be able to load SQLite tables directly into R using
Deducer's data loader.

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Feature request: SQLite import
parts:
Thank you for the suggestion. It would be very non-trivial to
incorporate the SQLite package in a useful way. I've never used it so
it would take some time for me to map out an appropriate GUI interface
for it. I'll definitely keep it in mind for future development
especially if a lot of Deducer users also use SQLite.

Cheers,
Ian
